text:
mike: Heads up: after last night's driver hotpatch (NVIDIA 535.86 -> 536.x) we're seeing several nodes where MIG slices disappeared and device UUIDs don't match kubelet inventory. Pods failing with CUDA allocation errors.

ashley: Which nodes? can you paste the node names? any pattern (region, instance type)?

mike: gpunode-3a, gpunode-7b, gpunode-9c — all p4d-ish in us-west1, same kernel 6.1. Looks like MIG configs got reset after the driver restarted.

kevin: I saw a similar symptom on a canary earlier. `nvidia-smi mig -L` returns "No MIG devices found", but `nvidia-smi -q` shows the GPU is healthy. NVML UUIDs are different from what's in /var/lib/kubelet/gpu-ids.

infra-bot: Incident INC-2026-4321 created: MIG slices missing on 3 nodes. Pager: @sre-oncall

sre-oncall: I'm on it. Quick check: please ssh and run `sudo nvidia-smi -mig -c 1`? Warning: that will wipe existing MIG config if any.

mike: Running diagnostic now. Example quick check:
```bash
ssh gpunode-3a 'sudo nvidia-smi -L'
# returns: No MIG devices found
```

rita: Don't run `-c 1` blindly. These nodes have running pods pinned to slices. We should cordon/drain first and then reconcile with our script that attempts to map old slice metadata to current NVML.

kevin: I pushed a helper: `scripts/mig-reconcile --node gpunode-3a --backup /tmp/migbak.json --dry-run` it reads `/var/lib/gpu-mapping.json` and will print the replayed `nvidia-smi mig -cgi` commands without applying.

ashley: Action plan:
1) Cordon + drain gpunode-7b
2) Run migrate-reconcile in dry-run, compare mappings
3) If mappings clean, apply and uncordon; else rollback the driver on that node to 531.x and notify infra.
We'll do one node at a time and pause the rest of the hotpatch rollout in us-west1.

mike: Starting with gpunode-7b now, cordoning and draining.

mike: Dry-run output shows mapping mismatch error: "expected GPU_UUID=GPU-1234, NVML reports GPU-5678" and reconcile would recreate slices but with new UUIDs; kubelet wouldn't bind existing pod annotations. We need to recreate pods or update annotations.

kevin: Likely cause: device ordering changed after driver reload + udev symlinks got regenerated differently. Kubelet's symlink cache wasn't refreshed. Fix options: re-run nvidia-operator preflight to reconcile symlinks or patch kubelet to rescan gpus (we have a small script `k8s-rescan-gpus.sh`).

rita: I'll add a short-term monitor: if `nvidia-smi mig -L` count != expected_count OR `/var/lib/kubelet/gpu-ids` mismatch > 0 then create alert and mark node with `gpu-drift=true`.

ashley: We'll pause remaining driver upgrades in us-west1 and rollback canaries. Ops will run the reconcile + pod recreation workflow for the three affected nodes. Update incident when gpunode-7b is back in service.

infra-bot: INC-2026-4321 status: investigation — next update in 30m.
